name: Mykolas Romeris University
summary: Vilnius university strong in law and social sciences; nine English-taught bachelor's from law and psychology to business, languages and game design.

ib.text: Upload your IB diploma and results; at least 60% of the maximum grade average is needed. English at B2 by test, or no certificate if your studies were fully in English. Motivation letter required.

programmes.name: Business Management and Startup Building
programmes.about: Three years of building a real start-up: idea validation, a first product, sales and scaling into a company, with lean start-up methods throughout.
programmes.overview: Year one teaches the lean start-up method, the lean business model canvas, Google Sprint and design thinking, together with business fundamentals, idea validation and pitching. Year two adds technical and analytical skills, sales techniques and customer acquisition, and you build a minimum viable product and test it with real customers. In year three you scale the venture into an operating company and prepare it for investors, ending at a Demo Day. Core subjects include programming, digital product design, finance, cybersecurity, digital marketing and business law, with mentors and partners such as Startup Lithuania. Graduates become product owners, business developers, digital marketers and founders.
programmes.selectionNote: Competition on your school grades (60% average minimum) and motivation letter; MRU may add an English, maths or interview check. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Global Business and Modern Marketing
programmes.about: Reading and analysing business data for decisions across finance, marketing and human resources, with business psychology, digital marketing and project management.
programmes.overview: Over three years you study management, micro- and macroeconomics, business statistics and mathematics, human resource management, marketing and market research, business databases and analysis, entrepreneurship, social media marketing, international trade, brand management, project management and business risk management, plus a professional foreign language (English, French or German). Electives include business psychology, leadership, sales management, intercultural management and social entrepreneurship. The final year has an internship and a bachelor thesis, and Erasmus+ exchanges are encouraged. Graduates work in business management, banks, companies and government institutions.
programmes.selectionNote: Competition on your school grades (60% average minimum) and motivation letter; MRU may add an English, maths or interview check. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Communication and Digital Marketing
programmes.about: Social media, digital advertising and creative content, with project management and additional languages; a double-degree option exists with Kiel University of Applied Sciences.
programmes.overview: Over six semesters you study communication theory, public relations, journalism in the era of disinformation, digital and social network marketing, data analytics, creative writing and advertising texts, digital advertising design, gamification, e-business, startups, electronic publishing, ethics, law and crisis communication, with English, French or German. Projects and creative management and leadership methods are woven in, a fifth-semester internship comes first, and a term paper and bachelor thesis end the degree. Erasmus+ study or internships abroad are possible. Graduates work as SEO and SEM specialists, public relations specialists, content managers and marketers.
programmes.selectionNote: Competition on your school grades (60% average minimum) and motivation letter; MRU may add an English, maths or interview check. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Law and Global Security
programmes.about: Law applied to personal, national and global security: cyberattacks, money laundering, human rights and terrorism, with research, negotiation and leadership skills.
programmes.overview: The foundation is constitutional, criminal, civil, administrative, international public and EU law, with theory of law and a professional foreign language. On top come security-focused courses: terrorism and Europe's security, migration and trafficking, anti-corruption instruments, human security law and AI, energy security law, armed conflicts law, cyber security and AI, anti-money laundering, environmental law and intellectual property theft. Teaching uses lectures, seminars, mooting, gamification and talks by experts, and you meet partner organisations from national and international bodies. The final year has a substantial internship and a thesis. Graduates work in human rights, compliance, anti-money laundering and energy or other security roles.
programmes.selectionNote: Competition on your school grades (60% average minimum) and motivation letter; MRU may add an English, maths or interview check. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: Basics and history of psychology, clinical and business psychology and statistical analysis; meets the European Federation of Psychologists' Associations bachelor requirements.
programmes.overview: Seven semesters run from general psychology, philosophy, logic and human anatomy and physiology through perception, memory, learning, thinking and language, to clinical, organisational, educational, forensic and health psychology, with psychopathology, neuropsychology, human genetics, psychological testing, research methods and statistics. Communication skills training, observation and survey skills and psychophysiological measurement laboratories build practice. The final semester has an internship, and a bachelor thesis is supervised individually. Partners include the military, child protection services and correctional departments. Graduates work in social work, human resources and therapy, or continue to doctoral study.
programmes.selectionNote: Competition on your school grades (60% average minimum) and motivation letter; MRU may add an English, maths or interview check. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: English for Specific Purposes and the Second Foreign Language
programmes.about: Philology studied in English with a second language of your choice (French, German, Norwegian, Spanish, Korean or Chinese) for work in translation, media and international organisations.
programmes.overview: English phonetics, morphology and syntax, linguistics and literary analysis are combined with English for specific purposes in four domains (business, public administration, law and finance), translation, corpus-driven analysis and terminology research. A second foreign language is studied for six semesters from French, German, Spanish, Norwegian, Chinese or Korean. The final year has professional practice and a bachelor thesis, and Erasmus+ exchange allows study and internships at European or Asian universities. Graduates work in culture and information centres, media, publishing, tourism, translation agencies, international organisations and state departments.
programmes.selectionNote: Competition on your school grades (60% average minimum) and motivation letter; MRU may add an English, maths or interview check. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: English for Specific Purposes and Korean Studies
programmes.about: English philology with Korean language and culture at the King Sejong Institute in Vilnius, including a compulsory year of study in South Korea or another European university.
programmes.overview: English studies (phonetics, morphology, syntax, corpus-driven lexicology, discourse analysis, literary analysis, academic writing and translation basics) are paired with four semesters of Korean and electives on Korean reading, conversation and history, plus English for business, public administration, law and finance. One semester is spent on Korean studies in South Korea or at a partner university in Europe in year three. A term paper, professional practice and a bachelor thesis finish the degree, and Korean is taught through the King Sejong Institute in Vilnius. Graduates work in translation, public administration, international organisations and tourism offices.
programmes.selectionNote: Competition on your school grades (60% average minimum) and motivation letter; MRU may add an English, maths or interview check. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: Taught in English; English at B1 is the stated entry level, and a year abroad is compulsory.

programmes.name: Digital Media Design
programmes.about: Joint programme with Dongseo University: coding, UI/UX, 3D modelling, service design and VR, two years in Vilnius and two in South Korea. Shares admission with Game Development.
programmes.overview: The first years combine contemporary mathematics, Python programming, object-oriented design, data structures and databases with computer graphics, matte painting, 3D modelling and animation, motion graphics, cinematography and editing, web design, game design, human-centered design and visual effects, with two years of Korean. Two years are spent in Lithuania and two at Dongseo University in South Korea, where two capstone design internships and a two-part bachelor thesis fall in the later years. Graduates work in TV and production companies, motion graphics studios, virtual reality, 3D modelling, game development and UI and UX design.
programmes.selectionNote: Competition on your school grades (60% average minimum) and motivation letter; MRU may add an English, maths or interview check. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: Two years in Lithuania, then two at Dongseo University in South Korea, which charges $5,600 a year (2026/27).

programmes.name: Game Development and Digital Animation
programmes.about: Programming, mathematics, 3D animation and game design, finishing with your own game; two years in Vilnius and two at Dongseo University in South Korea.
programmes.overview: The degree covers contemporary mathematics, Python, object-oriented design, data structures, databases, AI programming and game engine architectures, with figure drawing, computer graphics, 3D Maya modelling, character animation, compositing, lighting and rendering, game design, level design and 2D and 3D game programming, plus Korean. After year two you lean toward Game Development or Animation and VFX. You design a game from scratch and make your own game as a final project, with two capstone design internships and a bachelor thesis in year four. Two years are at Dongseo University in South Korea. Graduates work in computer games, film, advertising, art and design.
programmes.selectionNote: Competition on your school grades (60% average minimum) and motivation letter; MRU may add an English, maths or interview check. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: Two years in Lithuania, then two at Dongseo University in South Korea, which charges $5,600 a year (2026/27).

notes: Fees are the same for EU and non-EU students: €3,250 to €4,200 a year in 2026/27, with the 2027/28 estimate on each programme's application page; the EU application fee is €50 and a €50 registration fee follows.
Applications for 2026/27 were open from 1 January; non-EU applicants closed 1 June and EU/EFTA applicants 24 July; the 2027 dates are not yet published.
The national joint-admission list (LAMA BPO) also carries English versions of Psychology, Global Business, Communication and others; ask MRU whether state-funded places exist for EU citizens.
